summary: Fox Factory Holding Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary Fox Factory, Inc. sold all shares of Wheelhouse Holdings, parent of Marucci Sports, to Squared Up Holdings, an acquisition vehicle led by Marucci senior management. The deal closed September 25, 2026, at a $225M enterprise value: $200M cash and a $24.7M unsecured subordinated convertible note due December 31, 2026, bearing 4.55% PIK interest stepping to 10% post-maturity. Cash proceeds repaid credit facility borrowings; ~$7.5M transaction costs paid separately. A $250,000 purchase-price collar applies. Watch note repayment/conversion risk.
